headline: Germany's hybrid-threat ledger fills up, Audacity ships a Qt rebuild, and BepiColombo drops its transfer module at Mercury.

stories.title: BKA counts 165 sabotage suspects this year
facts: Confidential BKA Lagebild (to end-Aug): 165+ sabotage-suspicion cases nationwide
24 espionage probes opened this year, 12 of them cyber-espionage; 40 more under review
Police logged 112 espionage-related offences; 60+ were illegal filming of military/defence sites
747 drone incidents, 1,068 drones over critical infra, military sites and arms firms
Recent grid attacks: improvised rockets with copper wire at Jänschwalde (BB) and Bergheim (NRW); terror/verfassungsfeindliche Sabotage probes
July: Moldovan arrested in Bavaria after drone recon of KNDS; investigators suspect Russian state tasking
stories.whyItMatters: The hybrid-defence centre's own ledger now puts numbers on a threat Germany has been talking about in headlines — grid, drones, and spying in one package.

stories.title: Audacity 4 rebuilds on Qt
facts: Audacity 4.0 released: UI rebuilt on Qt with native high-DPI
New clip model: multi-select, groups, freer mono/stereo moves; dedicated split tool (S)
Workspaces (Modern/Classic/Music), themes, Home screen with project thumbnails
New .aup4 format; .aup3 opens and converts one-way
Gone for now: Time Tracks, Note/MIDI, Mixer, Macro Manager, VAMP/LADSPA, play-at-speed
Windows builds gain ASIO; VST3/Nyquist/LV2/AU plugin path kept
stories.whyItMatters: The default open-source audio editor just took its biggest interface break in years — expect muscle-memory pain and a flood of 3.x holdouts.

image.alt: Audacity 4.0 Audacity 4 rebuilds the application interface on Qt and introduces many new quality-of-life improvements, including a new clip-editing model. Most Audacity 3 workflows remain available...

stories.title: BepiColombo sheds its transfer module at Mercury
facts: ESA confirmed MTM separation today: signal acquired via Cebreros and Malargüe (~15:52 CEST)
Telemetry nominal; MPO solar panels charging the stack
After ~8 years and >200 million km, ESA MPO + JAXA Mio now head to Mercury orbit
Orbit insertion planned 21 Nov 2026; MPO/Mio separate 9–10 Dec; science phase April 2027
stories.whyItMatters: Europe and Japan are finally turning the cruise into an orbital mission at the Solar System's hardest inner planet.

stories.title: Polars 2.0 RC makes streaming the default
facts: First Polars 2.0 release candidate; final 2.0 due in coming weeks
LazyFrame.collect now defaults to the streaming engine (claimed ~5× aggregate speedups)
Row order no longer guaranteed for join/group_by/unpivot unless maintain_order is set
Stricter is_in and horizontal concat; many silent casts removed
Install: pip install polars==2.0rc1; migration guide published
stories.whyItMatters: A major-version bump that is mostly about safer defaults and memory — data pipelines will need order and cast audits.

stories.title: Berlin rewires Gewerbesteuer for data centres
facts: Cabinet draft for Einkommensteuerreformgesetz 2027 changes trade-tax splitting for pure data-centre operators
~90% of Gewerbesteuer would stick at the server-farm site (via non-redundant electrical capacity), only ~10% by wages
Today's wage-heavy formula leaves host towns with infrastructure costs and little tax
Rule starts Erhebungszeitraum 2027; framed as fulfilling the federal data-centre strategy and damping local protests
stories.whyItMatters: Germany is trying to buy local acceptance for AI power plants with tax cash, not just zoning papers.

stories.title: Gemini voice reaches Gmail, Docs and Keep
facts: Sundar Pichai: new Gemini voice can search Gmail, organize Keep, and create Docs conversationally
GoogleAI also launched WeatherNext 3, rolling into Search, Gemini, Maps and Earth Engine
Workspace voice features (Gmail Live / Docs Live / Keep) have been staged for AI Pro/Ultra and business tiers
stories.whyItMatters: Google is pushing voice as the Workspace front door the same day its weather model lands in consumer surfaces.

stories.title: Cursor Cloud Agents can run in Vercel Sandbox
facts: Cursor Cloud Agents can execute in Vercel Sandbox instead of Cursor-hosted machines
Cursor keeps the harness/inference loop; Self-Hosted Machines APIs need Cursor Enterprise
Each agent request gets an isolated Firecracker microVM; Functions + Workflow claim/cleanup workers
Pitch: scale-to-zero pool, durable retries, short-lived user-scoped credentials
stories.whyItMatters: Agent runtimes are becoming a cloud product surface — useful if you already live on Vercel and want isolation without owning VMs.

stories.title: ICANN greenlights killing .name third-levels
facts: Verisign proposed ending the entire 3rd-level .name hierarchy (Apr); ICANN approved 28 Jul
Neil Fraser: neil.fraser.name (paid to 2040) vanishes in February; ~22,000 registrants affected
Risk: vacant 2nd-levels re-registered, then old emails/IoT auth hijacked

stories.title: ChatGPT/Claude/Grok outage marked resolved
facts: OpenAI status: elevated ChatGPT/Codex errors resolved (monitoring from ~11:17 PT, resolved ~12:55 PT)
Anthropic and xAI also posted elevated-error incidents earlier; Gemini had no official outage
9to5Google: Cursor reported impact from Claude/Grok; Azure outage reports spiked in parallel (causation unconfirmed)
